_comment: Test type-checking overlay. Combine with a package's own tsconfig.json via array extends, package's config FIRST so this one's overrides win: "extends": ["./tsconfig.json", "@internal/typescript-config/tests.json"]. tsc -b's composite mode requires declaration emit, and test files must never land in dist/, so those two constraints can't share one tsconfig. This overlay turns emit off entirely and drops composite/incremental so a plain `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` type-checks src + test files together without writing anything - it is never built with -b and nothing references it as a project reference.
